name: When do I need professional infectious disease cleanup?

mainEntity.name: When do I need professional infectious disease cleanup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional infectious disease cleanup is necessary after confirmed or suspected outbreaks of highly contagious illnesses, such as COVID-19, influenza, or norovirus, in your home or business. It's also recommended after incidents involving biohazardous materials like blood or bodily fluids, or in high-traffic commercial spaces requiring enhanced sanitization. While routine cleaning addresses everyday dirt, professional services use specialized equipment and disinfectants to eliminate unseen pathogens, ensuring a deeper level of decontamination that is crucial for public health and safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional cleanup is needed after confirmed infectious disease outbreaks, incidents with biohazardous materials, or for enhanced sanitization in high-traffic areas.
